description: Lists the eSIM plans that Horizon sells now for one destination (a country or a region): the data amount, the number of days, the unlimited flag, the price in EUR and a link to each plan's page on horizonesim.com. Takes the destination's English name or slug, for example "Netherlands", "United States" or "europe". Prices and links are current when returned; the plan page shows the final price before purchase.

destination.description: The English name or the slug of a country or region, for example "Netherlands", "usa", "balkans" or "europe".

name: list_destination_plans
title: Destination plans and prices
